sentences.text:
Mr. Pankaj Kumar Sharma, Advocate for the informant
 appeared through video conferencing.

Hon'ble Ravindra Maithani, J. (Oral)
The applicant seeks anticipatory bail in FIR/Case Crime No.748 of 2023, dated 23.12.2023, under
Sections 120-B, 420, 467, 468, 471 Ipc, Police Station Gangnahar, District Haridwar.

2. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
3.
According to the FIR, the co-accused sold the property of the informant based on the forged power of attorney.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant would submit that the applicant is nowhere in the case; he did not execute any power of attorney; he did not execute any sale-deed; he is not a beneficiary.
5. Learned counsel for the informant would submit that, in fact, according to the co-accused the idea of committing the offence was given by the applicant.
6. State as well as informant to file objections.

Having considered, as an ad-interim measure, till the next date of listing, in the eventuality of arrest, the applicant shall be released on bail subject to his furnishing personal bond and two sureties, to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer ("AO"), subject to the following:-
(i) The applicant shall not approach in any manner, whatsoever, the victim or/and any of the witness in the case.
(ii) He shall cooperate with the investigation.
